description: This is a PHP source file defining the Stream class in the Nyholm PSR-7 implementation, which implements the StreamInterface for handling stream resources and provides methods for stream manipulation.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Implements the PSR-7 StreamInterface, managing PHP resources for stream operations with additional capabilities like seeking, reading, writing, and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Stream instance from a string, resource, or existing StreamInterface.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that closes the stream resource when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream and releases the resource.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the underlying resource from the stream object, resetting internal state.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream content if available.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the file pointer.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at the end.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position within the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Reads remaining contents of the stream.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about the stream or specific key if provided.
